sections.title: Enemies
sections.blurb: Draft enemy ideas and how evil works

questions.prompt: Keep the draft enemy list (Tipped Wisps, Ashavar-Kan Fallen, Stained Neighbors, Hollow Makers, Unmakers, Mist Walkers, Empire Censors, Corrupted Guardsmen, Pride Echo, Ashar-Kan)?
options: Keep all
Keep most, cut a few
Keep as ideas only
Start over

questions.prompt: Final boss 'Ashar-Kan' — but the lore says Ashar-Kan is a mistaken title. Who is the real final enemy?
options: The fallen two-thirds of Ashavar acting together
The first leaner of Ashavar (the Ancient Enemy)
A human who takes the Ashar-Kan title
There is no single boss — the canal itself

questions.prompt: What are Tipped Wisps?
options: Small spirits that tipped with the Fall
Whispers that grew bodies
Glimmers that were corrupted
Lost souls stuck at a crossing

questions.prompt: Hollow Makers (fallen Kembar): what do they make?
options: Things that can only be owned, not used
Corrupted spirit-tech
Empty bodies for spirits to wear
Copies that look real but are hollow

questions.prompt: Unmakers (fallen Nurest) — evil cannot truly unmake. So what do they do?
options: Smash and leave a stain
Bring death too early
Stop death and harvest, so nothing renews
Make people fear all endings

questions.prompt: Empire Censors — who are they?
options: Officials who run the census of the corrupted
A secret police inside the Empire
Spirits pretending to be officials
Good people doing a wrong job

questions.prompt: Corrupted Guardsmen — when do they appear?
options: Book 1, as the Imperial traitor
After Cassian's plan comes out
Rarely — a big twist
As a constant fear in the Guard

questions.prompt: Can corrupted enemies be saved?
options: Yes — the Flame casts corruption out without killing the host
Some can, some chose too long
Only humans
Only with Grace (the Breath) and their own choice

questions.prompt: What are Mist Walkers?
options: Stained Thalorim (ushers) who lead people wrong at thin places
Sleep-counterfeits from the Enemy (stained Shaveth)
Desert raiders using spirit-tech
Ghost-like scouts of the Korvan Dominion

questions.prompt: The bible's evil minions (Whispers, Watchers, Furies, Clingers, Devourers, Lures, Weights) — how do they fit with the new list?
options: Both — minions feed sins, the new list is bigger enemies
Replace the minions with the new list
Minions are spiritual only; the new list is physical
Merge them into one list

sections.title: Story Spine & Plot
sections.blurb: Book 1 and the big shape of the series

questions.prompt: How does Book 1 open?
options: Special Service selection and training (bible)
In the middle of a mission, then flashback to training
Meeting the Banner (the comic)
A myth prologue from the Letters, then training

questions.prompt: Book 1's first command: a silent frontier region, missing patrols, humans blaming spirit-humanoids. Where?
options: The Farm Kingdom's northern forest edge, where unknown things and wood/mountain elves keep attacking
The Desert Kingdom border
The Northern Mountains
Near the Everlight Forest

questions.prompt: The desert kingdom is already 75% conquered and Rashid commands the war there. When do Alaric and Seraphina join it?
options: Book 1
End of Book 1
Book 2
Later in the series

questions.prompt: What is the enemy really after under the north-west fortress city?
options: An ancient spirit crossing
A corrupted Flame relic
A spirit-tech installation
An old betrayal's buried evidence
A tunnel through the mountains

questions.prompt: When do Alaric and Seraphina learn Cassian's real plan (to use corruption to save humanity)?
options: End of Book 1, when he promises to investigate because he's part of it
Middle of the series
Near the end
Seraphina finds out first, long before anyone

questions.prompt: Is Cassian a villain, or does he think he's right?
options: He truly believes he's saving humanity, a tragic villain
He starts right and slides into Pride
He's right about the Empire but wrong about corruption
The story never fully decides

questions.prompt: Series thesis: which line matters most?
options: Not every monster is corrupted
Not every corrupted person is beyond saving
Not every evil act needs a spirit
All three equally

questions.prompt: How long is the story?
options: One big book
Trilogy
Five books
Ongoing comic series

questions.prompt: Whose eyes do we follow?
options: Mostly Alaric
Alaric and Seraphina, switching
The whole Banner
Mostly Seraphina

questions.prompt: Alaric's older brother in the Flame Order — when does he appear?
options: Late — family is revealed slowly
Book 2
Only in mentions
When the Flame Order is needed in Book 1

questions.prompt: How does the whole story end?
options: Alaric finally asks for help, and that saves everyone
The Empire is humbled, not destroyed
Alaric and Seraphina build their life — quietly happy
Bittersweet — victory with a cost
